description.en: Curated collection of CSS transition recipes, custom easings, and animations.
description.zh: 精选现代 CSS 动画过渡配方、自定义贝塞尔缓动曲线与动效实验场。

content.en: Transitions.dev is an interactive laboratory and reference guide for pure CSS transition timing functions and physics easings. Curated for motion designers and design engineers, it offers visual cubic-bezier curves, spring approximation presets, and drop-in keyframe recipes.
content.zh: Transitions.dev 是一座面向动效工程师与设计工程师的现代 CSS 过渡曲线实验场。它可视化收录并对比了数十种高质感的贝塞尔缓动函数、弹簧物理近似曲线以及即拷即用的 CSS 关键帧配方，帮助网页元素摆脱生硬机械感。
